title: Comfort as a Constraint or as a Cost in Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Building Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.20889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A building controller that keeps a zone within comfort bounds at minimum energy can treat the bounds as a soft constraint, by adding the weighted violation to its cost, or as a hard constraint. We analyze the effect of the hard and the soft formulation of the same problem and isolate the effect of the formulation from the effect of the algorithm. To this end, we measure the difference in energy use between the two formulations on the BOPTEST bestest_hydronic_heat_pump case, in model predictive control (MPC) and in reinforcement learning (RL). The soft formulations are a weighted MPC and weighted SAC and DDPG learners, each at twelve weights. The hard formulations are an MPC with an exact penalty and the Lagrangian learners SAC-Lagrangian and primal-dual DDPG. translated_title: 在强化学习与模型预测建筑控制中，将舒适性作为约束还是作为代价
translated_abstract: 一种建筑控制器若要在最小能耗下将区域保持在舒适范围内，可以将舒适边界作为软约束处理，即在代价函数中加入加权后的违反量，也可以将其作为硬约束处理。我们分析了同一问题的硬约束与软约束两种表述的效果，并将表述方式的影响与算法的影响分离开来。为此，我们在BOPTEST的bestest_hydronic_heat_pump案例上，分别在模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习（RL）中测量了两种表述在能耗上的差异。软约束表述包括加权MPC以及加权的SAC和DDPG学习器，每种各取十二个权重。硬约束表述包括带精确罚函数的MPC以及拉格朗日学习器SAC-Lagrangian和原始-对偶DDPG。我们发现，在最大权重下，硬约束表述比软约束表述消耗更多能量，但对舒适边界的违反更少。对于较大的权重，软约束表述……
tldr: 该研究在模型预测控制和强化学习中系统比较了建筑控制里将舒适边界作为硬约束与软约束两种表述方式，发现硬约束表述能耗更高但对舒适边界的违反更少，从而将表述方式的影响与算法本身的影响分离开来。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares hard-constraint versus soft-constraint formulations of comfort bounds in building control across MPC and reinforcement learning, finding that hard formulations consume more energy but violate comfort bounds less, thereby isolating the effect of the formulation from that of the algorithm.
